en.title: This Bird Turns Into a Tree Stump. Can You Name It?
en.description: This is the great potoo. By day it perches upright and looks like part of a tree stump, then hunts large insects, and sometimes bats and birds, at night. It lays a single egg in a shallow dip on a thick branch.
